newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Korea Green Cross to buy back shares.
newsitem.headline: Korea Green Cross to buy back shares.

text.p: Korea Green Cross Co, one of South Korea's leading pharmaceutical makers, said on Monday it planned to buy back 40,000 of its own preferred shares on the open market between March 14 and June 13 to boost their price.
The buyback, representing 23.97 percent of the company's preferred shares issued, will be handled through LG Securities, Korea Green Cross said in a statement.
Buy orders for the shares will be placed at the previous day's closing price, the statement said.
The company currently holds 0.21 percent of its own common shares and 0.13 percent of preferred shares, it added.
